title: R+D Community Project
description: Canonical contract for the legacy mods/<product>/<author>/<project_slug>/mod.yml interface. The product key identifies the project ecosystem; mod.yml, mod_version, and mod-lint retain their legacy names for compatibility. Enforced by mod-lint.

title.description: Human-readable project name shown on the gallery card.

author.description: GitHub username; must match the author folder name.

product.description: Legacy key identifying the project's ecosystem; must match the ecosystem folder.

description.description: Short description shown on the gallery card.

mod_version.description: Legacy catalog-entry version; start at 1 and increment when the entry changes.

compatibility.description: Models / firmware revisions actually tested. Do not list untested ones.

images.description: Non-empty list of project images. Local paths are relative to mod.yml and must exist; indexed projects may use HTTP(S) URLs.

source_url.description: Set for an indexed project whose files live in the author's upstream repository. Omit for a project hosted in this repository.

license.description: Required for every project. Use the disclosed upstream SPDX identifier or LicenseRef-* for an indexed project; mod-lint verifies registered identifiers and canonical spelling. A hosted OSSM project must use CERN-OHL-S-2.0; another hosted project may use any disclosed SPDX identifier or LicenseRef-* and must include its license text at the project root.

safety.description: Required safety disclosure. Projects touching these areas receive human safety review.

notes.description: Describe any safety-relevant behavior, or '–' if none.
